# MoldStud

> > MoldStud is a technology career platform featuring remote engineering positions across software development, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, security, and machine learning domains.

MoldStud aggregates remote job opportunities for software engineers, data professionals, and security specialists working with technologies like AWS, Python, TypeScript, React, Kubernetes, and more. The platform focuses on distributed teams and remote-first positions across various seniority levels.

## Key Topics

- Remote engineering positions
- AWS, GCP, Azure cloud platforms
- Python, TypeScript, JavaScript development
- React and frontend frameworks
- Kubernetes and microservices
- Application security and vulnerability management
- Data engineering and ETL pipelines
- Machine learning and LLM systems
- Full-stack development
- DevOps and cloud infrastructure
- Node.js and backend services
- SQL and business intelligence
- Distributed systems architecture
- Mobile development (React Native)
- Developer relations and advocacy

- [Senior Full Stack Engineer - Remote](https://moldstud.com/careers/senior-full-stack-engineer-remote): Senior fullstack position building AI solutions with React and NodeJS/NestJS

- [Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Frameworks & Tooling Expert](https://moldstud.com/careers/senior-machine-learning-engineer-frameworks-tooling-expert): Senior ML Systems Engineer for LLM training with JAX/CUDA expertise
- [Senior .NET/AWS Engineer - Remote](https://moldstud.com/careers/senior-net-aws-engineer-remote): Senior .NET/AWS Engineer for cloud migration in educational technology
- [Experienced Remote Mobile Developer for Senior Roles](https://moldstud.com/careers/experienced-remote-mobile-developer-for-senior-roles): Senior Mobile Engineer role for React Native iOS/Android development
